text: Refine-time doctor red by construction: a milestone that declares fitness functions in ARCHITECTURE.md before aof:verify authors VERIFICATION.md gets an ERROR-severity verification-register-missing from aof work doctor (measured: 71 and 63 both carry it; 37 and 52 carry the warn form after accept). Every milestone between refine and verify is therefore red on a code that 54/ADR-007 deliberately excludes from the loop gate. Worth deciding whether the finding should be acceptance-horizon-scoped like 66/ADR-002's other checks, or whether the milestone scaffold should ship VERIFICATION.md with an empty register.
